tracks.title: Minecraft
tracks.evidence: Same-recording-content waveform match to the artist-hosted recording "Minecraft" by C418, track 8 of Minecraft - Volume Alpha, https://c418.bandcamp.com/track/minecraft (track_id 1691975503). qa/artesian-music/canonical-proof.json and offline-waveform-proof.json retain exact source queries, reference SHA256, full-recording cross-correlation searches, and 11 wrong-track controls. Both source windows and four independent subwindows recover source-minus-reference offset 82.679875 seconds at 8 kHz. Composer credit: https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/credits explicitly lists Daniel Rosenfeld under "Music composed by"; qa/artesian-music/credits.json preserves this primary credit and the artist-hosted recording credit, with Library of Congress-hosted supporting evidence identifying C418 as Rosenfeld's stage name. The recording is credited to C418; no separately named instrumental performer is established, so performer remains null. The video's description credits only Beethoven for titles and cinematics and does not name this cue. Cached 120–132-second and fresh 122.1–134.1-second Shazam signatures were unmatched with HTTP200; exact identity comes from the reference waveform comparison, not either nonmatch. No direct listening claim or full cue boundaries.
